sources.content: # AGENTS.md for Kalvorin. Kalvorin generates and sends invoices for subscription businesses. The backend is Elixir 1.17 on Phoenix; start it locally with `mix phx.server`, which serves on port 4000. Run tests with `mix test`. Database migrations live in `priv/repo/migrations/` and run with `mix ecto.migrate`. Invoice PDFs are rendered by a separate Node service in `pdf/`, started with `npm run start` on port 4010. Load local seed data with `mix run priv/repo/seeds.exs`.

Billing rules. Invoice numbers are sequential per account and must never be reused, even after a void. A sent invoice is never edited; corrections go out as a credit note linked to the original. Tax amounts are computed by `Kalvorin.Tax.calculate/2` and nowhere else. Due dates default to net 30. Overdue reminders go out 3, 7 and 14 days after the due date. Any change to `lib/kalvorin/ledger/` needs two approving reviews.

claims.text: In Kalvorin, corrections to a sent invoice go out as a credit note linked to the original.

Kalvorin database migrations run with mix ecto.migrate.

Kalvorin's backend runs on Elixir 1.17 with Phoenix.
